description: Implement `list_target_files`: recursively walk each directory in `dirs`, expanding a leading `~` to the value of `$HOME`. Collect regular files whose name ends with any extension in `exts`. Allocate a NULL-terminated array of newly allocated path strings in `*out_paths` and return the number of paths. Skip unreadable directories. Return 0 with `*out_paths` NULL when none are found.
